q.age.why: Many schemes have minimum or maximum age limits.
q.gender.why: Some schemes are open only to women.
q.area.prompt: Do you live in a rural or an urban area?
q.area.why: Housing and several other schemes differ for villages and towns.
q.occupation.why: Many schemes are meant for farmers, students, artisans, street vendors and other groups.
q.annual_income.prompt: What is the approximate yearly income of your household?
q.annual_income.why: Some schemes have an income limit.
q.annual_income.hint: Total for the whole household, in rupees per year
q.category.prompt: Which social category does your family belong to?
q.category.why: Some scholarships and benefits are reserved for certain categories.
q.priority_household.prompt: Does your household have a BPL, Antyodaya (AAY) or priority-household ration card?
q.priority_household.why: Several welfare schemes are meant for households with this card.
q.owns_farmland.why: Farmer income support is linked to land ownership.
q.owns_pucca_house.prompt: Does your household already own a pucca (permanent) house?
q.owns_pucca_house.why: Housing schemes are for households without a pucca house.
q.has_lpg.prompt: Does your household already have an LPG gas connection?
q.has_lpg.why: A free connection is offered only to households that do not have one.
q.pays_income_tax.why: Income tax payers are excluded from several schemes.
q.govt_employee.why: Government employees are excluded from several schemes.
q.is_widow.why: A pension is available for widows from eligible households.
q.pregnant_or_lactating.why: A maternity benefit is available for pregnant and breastfeeding mothers.
q.daughters_under_10.prompt: How many daughters below 10 years of age do you have?
q.daughters_under_10.why: A savings scheme is available for girls below 10 years of age.
q.post_matric_student.prompt: Are you studying in Class 11 or above?
q.post_matric_student.why: The scholarship covers education after Class 10.

help.title: How to use this service
help.subtitle: Short answers to common questions.
help.q1: How do I talk to the assistant?
help.a1: Open Talk, choose Start call and speak normally. The assistant answers aloud and then listens again. Speak over it at any time to interrupt. If you prefer to type, or cannot hear, switch to Text chat.
help.q2: How do I change the language?
help.a2: Use the language menu at the top of any page. The whole page, the assistant's replies and the scheme details switch to the language you pick, including in the middle of a conversation.
help.q3: How do I find out which schemes I can get?
help.a3: Ask the assistant in your own words, search in the Scheme finder with filters, or complete the Quick check. Each result explains which conditions you meet, which you do not, and what is still unknown.
help.q4: What happens when I upload a document?
help.a4: The document is read and checked. You see who it was issued to, until when it is valid, and whether it needs renewal soon. You can note where you keep the original so that you can find it later.
help.q5: Can the assistant help me fill in a form?
help.a5: Yes. Open the Form guide from a scheme page, or ask the assistant. It goes through the form field by field, speaks each field aloud, and fills in values from your own documents when they are available.
help.a6: Scheme details come from published guidelines and may change. Always confirm on the official website before you apply. Guidance for tasks that are not tied to a scheme is general advice prepared by AI.
privacy.title: Privacy and your data
privacy.subtitle: What is kept, where it is kept, and how to remove it.
privacy.s1_text: Your answers, conversation, documents' details, notes and settings are saved only in this browser on this device. The server does not keep them.
privacy.s2_text: Your messages, voice recordings and uploaded documents are sent to our service and to Sarvam AI only to answer you, read the document, speak the reply or translate. They are not stored on our server.
privacy.s3_text: Only what is needed to check a scheme is asked. You can skip any question. Only the last four characters of an ID number are kept from a document.
privacy.clear: Delete all my data from this browser
privacy.clear_confirm: This removes your answers, conversation, documents and settings from this browser. Delete everything?
privacy.cleared: Your data was deleted from this browser.
